notes.title: The Hardest Thing Ever Patch Notes [10/17/20]
The Hardest Thing Ever Patch Notes [9/15/20]
notes.content:
A new update 1.01 is available for The Hardest Thing Ever now. This update will automatically install when starting the Steam client, if it doesn’t install automatically, please restart Steam.

ENHANCEMENTS

 Reworked several levels (1/10, 1/16, 2/4, 2/12, 2/13);
 Improved some game physics.


GENERAL BUG FIXES

 Fixed some little bugs with helium physics;
 Optimization and increase performance.
